messages.author: 5b912777f7bfda3c
messages.subject: Group comparison 3.0
parts:
Hello,  I have been playing around with the newest version and the groupComparison function for a label free DDA experiment from Maxquant. It seems to behave differently than is documented in the 2.1.6 PDF manual

for example

testResultDDA<-groupComparison(contrast.matrix=comparison,data=DDAquant,labeled=FALSE,interference=FALSE,equalFeatureVar=FALSE)

does not work any more. Does the new version not need these values?

labeled=FALSE,interference=FALSE,equalFeatureVar=FALSE

if not does it just figure this out by itself?

thanks!

Brett

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Group comparison 3.0
parts:
Dear Brett,

Yes, new version of MSstats has some different options than MSstats v2.

 For groupComparison(contrast.matrix=comparison,data=DDAquant,labeled=FALSE,interference=FALSE,equalFeatureVar=FALSE) with v2, should be changed as below,

DDAquant<-dataProcess(raw, equalFeatureFar=FALSE) ## move to dataProcess step.

groupComparison(contrast.matrix=comparison,data=DDAquant)

you don't need to set labeled=FALSE (MSstats will recognize automatically). and now interference=FALSE doesn't need. (MSstats now use additive model, which means no interference)

To check options for new version,
?dataProcess 
?groupComparison 

and Please check R script for simple example DDA experiment, which will be similar with your dataset.(https://github.com/MeenaChoi/MSstats_material/tree/master/example%20dataset) some input and output from functions are changed.

If you have more question, please let us know.

-Meena
